_comment: Copy to storage/configs/automation_plan.json and edit. 'python cli.py run --plan' creates missing leagues/models, then refreshes, retrains and predicts. Leagues: country/name as in storage/configs/leagues.json. Markets ('targets'): Result, Result-U/O, U/O-1.5, U/O-3.5, BTTS, Home-U/O-0.5, Home-U/O-1.5, Away-U/O-0.5, Away-U/O-1.5, HT-Result, Home-Win-Either-Half, Away-Win-Either-Half, or 'all'. Classifiers: NaiveBayes, RandomForest, KNearestNeighbors, DiscriminantAnalysis, LogisticRegressor, SupportVectorMachine, DecisionTree, XGBoost, LightGBM.
